name: Tentacle and Witches
source:
Tachibana Ichirou, the protagonist, is an ordinary student; however he knows a secret.
That is, his teacher Yuuko is the owner of the mansion on the hill, and she is in fact a witch!
One evening, as a routine, he goes to the mansion to see her using the magic...

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE051557.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公橘一郎只是一名普通学生，却知道一个秘密。
他的老师悠子正是山丘上那栋宅邸的主人，而且她其实是一名魔女！
一天傍晚，他像往常一样前往宅邸，观看悠子施展魔法…

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE051557.html]DLsite English[/url]]
